title: Noahic Covenant
summary: God makes a covenant with Noah, his children and all living creatures. The rainbow marks the promise against another flood destroying all life.

title: Abrahamic Covenant
summary: God promises Abram land and many descendants, and says all families will be blessed through him. Circumcision, removal of the foreskin, becomes a sign of God's covenant with Abraham.

title: Sinai / Mosaic Covenant
summary: God calls Israel to keep the covenant. Moses reads the covenant book, and the people agree to follow its words.

title: Priestly Covenant with Phinehas
summary: God grants Phinehas a covenant of peace. The passage promises lasting priesthood to him and his descendants after his action among Israel.

title: Davidic Covenant
summary: God promises David a lasting house and kingdom. A psalm recalls the covenant and the promise to establish David's throne.

title: New Covenant
summary: Jeremiah describes a new covenant with God's law written in people's hearts. Jesus links the cup to a new covenant, and Hebrews quotes Jeremiah's promise.

title: Aaronic Blessing
summary: God tells Moses how Aaron and his sons should bless Israel. The words ask for God's care, favour and peace.

title: Parallel Accounts in Genesis
summary: Genesis first describes creation over six days, followed by rest. The next account describes the man, the garden, animals and the woman.
